record.field: ## Tool: Get Open Activities Retrieves all planned (open) activities on this lead, including type, summary, deadline, and assigned user. Always call this tool first before suggesting or creating new activities to avoid duplicates.

## Tool: Suggest Activities Analyses the lead's current stage, last contact date, and planned activities to suggest the most appropriate next steps. Use this tool when the user asks what to do next, or after reading a voice transcription summary to propose follow-ups.

## Tool: Create an Activity Creates a scheduled activity on this lead. Use this tool only after confirming the details with the user, or when explicitly asked to plan a follow-up from a voice transcription. Activity types: call, email, meeting, todo.
